{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"For all four datasets, replace single-negative BPR with full-catalog cross-entropy averaged equally over existing masked target positions. Catalog-wide competition may improve ranking discrimination. Preserve sampling, model architecture, tied embeddings, inference, optimizer and training settings.","edits":[{"find":"def bpr_sequence_loss(model: nn.Module, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    mask = (pos != 0).float()
    loss = -torch.log(torch.sigmoid(pos_scores - neg_scores) + 1e-8)
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)","replace":"def bpr_sequence_loss(model: nn.Module, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    out = model.encode_sequence(seq)
    mask = pos != 0
    masked_states = out[mask]
    targets = pos[mask] - 1
    # Only real item IDs 1..itemnum are prediction classes.
    logits = torch.nn.functional.linear(
        masked_states, model.item_emb.weight[1:model.itemnum + 1]
    )
    return torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, targets, reduction="mean")"}]}],"change_summary":"Replace BPR with full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. Padding and the exclusive mask token are excluded from output classes; checkpoint shapes and predictor remain compatible."}
